N: <int> Total number of elements to be partitioned into groups.
m: <int> Number of groups into which the elements must be partitioned.
group_capacities: <list[dict], length m> Capacity bounds for each group, where each entry contains:

group_capacities[*].L_g: <int> Minimum number of elements that must be assigned to this group.
group_capacities[*].U_g: <int> Maximum number of elements that may be assigned to this group.

distance_type: <str> Whether pairwise distances are real-valued ('real') or integer-valued ('int').
distance_range: <list[int], length 2> The lower and upper bounds of the range from which pairwise distances are drawn.
distances_upper_triangular: <list[float], length N*(N-1)/2> Pairwise distances between all distinct element pairs, stored as the upper triangle of the symmetric distance matrix in row-major order: d(0,1), d(0,2), ..., d(0,N-1), d(1,2), ..., d(N-2,N-1).
distance_format: <str> Description of how the upper-triangular distance entries are ordered.
num_distance_entries: <int> Total number of pairwise distance values stored, equal to N*(N-1)/2.
